name: Reach Ledger — per-channel last_proven_at
description: Tracks per-channel reach state (last_proven_at, last_failed_at, consecutive failures/successes) so cascade dispatchers can rank channels by freshness and circuit-break broken paths. The substrate that lets a multi-channel reach-cascade learn which path wins from one degradation event to the next. Salvages chuck-reach-ledger.mjs into a proper openclaw plugin with tool + programmatic API.

ledgerPath.label: Ledger file path
ledgerPath.help: Atomic-write JSON ledger location. Default preserves the chuck-v3 path so existing reach-ledger.json data survives the migration.

freshnessWindowMinutes.label: Freshness window (minutes)
freshnessWindowMinutes.help: Channels with last_proven_at within this window are promoted to the front of the cascade ranking.

circuitBreakerThreshold.label: Circuit-breaker failure count
circuitBreakerThreshold.help: After this many consecutive failures, a channel is pushed to the end of the cascade ranking (still tried, but only after all others).
